title: 2026 UK CBAM relief and repayment-record QA controls

sources.title: Keeping records for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
Claiming Carbon Price Relief for CBAM

facts.source_fact: Carbon Price Relief can reduce CBAM due where a qualifying carbon pricing charge has already applied to the goods' embodied emissions.
A carbon pricing verification form completed by a suitable verifier should be retained as evidence.
Relief records include the qualifying carbon pricing scheme involved.
Relief records include how the goods qualify, including verified effective-carbon-price calculations.
Records include which scheme elements were used to determine the carbon price.
Records include how CBAM liability was reduced, including exchange rates used to convert to GBP.
Repayment records include the reason for claim and date an error was found.
Repayment records include accounting period, affected goods and original payment date.
Repayment-claim records are retained for six years from the date the claim is sent.
HMRC states overpaid CBAM can only be repaid for the three years before a claim is made.
